premise: A luxury ship offers abundant supplies but becomes progressively smaller as infected decks are sealed and lower machinery spaces flood.
cast: Patch: existing orange forehead bandage identity, white circular head/white hands/feet, one grounded orange school backpack.
Mara: adult steward, dark blue work jacket and service keys; white circular head/white hands/feet, black stick limbs.
Ellis: adult passenger, burgundy sweater and dark trousers; white circular head/white hands/feet; sore knee after chute descent.
Infected passengers: green heads, hands and exposed feet, same pale green; no Patch bandage.
locations: Port cabins connect by balconies; hidden laundry passage joins pantry and crew stairs.
Guest pantry and galley lost; second laundry barricade preserves upper service access.
Forward stairs lead to bridge; lower workshop inaccessible through warped watertight door.
Numbered crew locker contains linen chute to workshop alcove.
Workshop ladder reaches starboard promenade and boat-three gate.
Starboard lifeboat reaches inlet beach and checked boathouse.
chronology: Days1-5: cabins, Mara, pantry, Ellis and lifeboat observation.
Day6: Ellis opens galley; pantry lost, second laundry barrier installed.
Days7-16: recovered keys, limited crew supplies, bridge and missing release handle; storm.
Days18-20: cabins abandoned; failed workshop route and flashlight lost.
Days21-26: inspect alternate route, locker/chute/workshop, handle recovered, sore knee, promenade access.
Days27-29: rough water and snagged lowering line delay launch; final supplies.
Day30: three launch together, land and inspect boathouse.
setups_and_payoffs: Intact starboard boat is seen before the missing handle is discovered and recovered.
Ellis causes pantry breach; later waits quietly at hatch and helps gate/boat crossing.
Storm closes cabin refuge and forces workshop/boat plan; launch ends the drifting-ship threat.
persistent_states: Pantry never becomes safe again; second cart is distinct from tipped pantry cart.
Mara keeps the returned spare keys; no second unexplained handover.
Flashlight crushed on failed descent and never restored.
Ellis carries sister's shoe and leaves it before departure; her fate remains unknown, no rescue promised.
Released boat-three handle recovered from workshop and installed at access gate.
Crew meal packs and drinks replace lost pantry supplies; no unshown food reset.
Backpack carried by visible handle only during movement; grounded when resting; never worn or duplicated.
visual_reference_status: Use existing preset main/drawing guide; prepare and inspect recurring side-character and new-location references before scenes.
